1.diagnosis: Bootstrap experiment for the QQQ variant. No prior champion exists; we are establishing the baseline. The FX project's single-model champion was XGBoost at seq_len=60 with composite +9.186 (Exp203 in the FX log) using max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.03, n_estimators=1500. Since QQQ is a different asset class with strong positive drift and ~+11%/yr buy-and-hold Sharpe, we cannot assume the same recipe wins, but it is the highest-prior starting point: XGBoost 2nd-order Newton boosting handles the tabular-style flattened features (104+ stack at seq=60 → 6,000+ inputs) well per Chen & Guestrin 2016 KDD. The 184 equity-native features include realised vol estimators, term-structure, sector breadth and credit spreads — all expected to add signal beyond what FX features captured.
1.citations: Chen & Guestrin 2016 KDD 'XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System' (arXiv:1603.02754) — 2nd-order Newton boosting with histogram method; recommended max_depth=4-6, learning_rate=0.03-0.1, n_estimators with early stopping for time-series tabular data. Welch & Goyal 2008 RFS 'A Comprehensive Look at the Empirical Performance of Equity Premium Prediction' — establishes the macro-spread feature set we mirror. Bollerslev, Tauchen & Zhou 2009 RFS 'Expected Stock Returns and Variance Risk Premia' — VRP feature is among our 184. Estrella & Mishkin 1998 RES 'Predicting U.S. Recessions' — 10y-3m yield-curve slope feature included.
1.hypothesis: XGBoost with max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.03, n_estimators=1500, seq_len=60, seed=42 will produce a positive composite score on QQQ. Mechanism: 2nd-order gradient information lets shallow trees fit the noise-corrupted return surface without overfitting, while seq_len=60 windowing supplies ~6,000 lagged feature columns that capture autocorrelation, trend, momentum, volatility regime, breadth and macro state. We expect lower absolute Sharpe than FX (because QQQ has positive bh_sharpe ≈ 0.7-1.0 over 2007-2025 reducing the marginal opportunity to time direction), but a NON-ZERO excess-Sharpe.
1.prediction: Composite (= min(test_A_sharpe, val_A_sharpe) - 0.1·n_negative_folds) in the +1.0 to +5.0 range. Test_A_sharpe in the +1.5 to +6.0 range. Excess-Sharpe (strategy_sharpe minus buy-and-hold_sharpe over the same windows) +1.0 to +5.0. Test_pos_folds ≥ 4/7. Aleatoric/epistemic not applicable (GBM, deterministic). Per-fold A_sharpe weakest in fold_5 (COVID shock, regime never seen during training).
